title: REST APIs
explanation: An API exposes operations and data through a contract. Resource-oriented HTTP APIs commonly use GET to read, POST to create, PATCH for partial updates and DELETE to remove.
Use status codes consistently: 200 for a successful response, 201 for creation, 400 for invalid input, 401 for missing/invalid authentication and 403 when access is forbidden.
Validate every request and enforce authorisation on every resource. Document request/response shapes and failure cases. A predictable error body helps clients recover.
exercise: Design endpoints for notes. Define one request, a successful response and an invalid-input response.
hint: Name resources rather than using paths such as /doEverything.

quiz.question: Which status commonly indicates successful creation?
quiz.explanation: 201 Created indicates that a request created a resource.
